scope: Finite CPU regression of the Projects application relative to real batched monitor geometry. No rendering or performance timing.

rayRegression.scope: All four rectangle corners plus edge midpoints; actual front-facing rendered mesh intersections before each application point. Hidden idle content is excluded. Hover rim geometry is included even at zero opacity to reserve the whole feedback footprint.

limits: Finite viewport, angle and perimeter samples, not a universal proof of all cameras or interrupted trajectories.
CPU rays do not evaluate AO shadow appearance, native HTML compositing, browser zoom, CSS layout, typography or video rendering. Root visual evidence covers those separately.
The application is a native HTML layer over WebGL. Keeping it inside the display rim avoids apparent overdraw; this does not introduce depth-tested DOM or new rendering passes.
testHarnessFollowup: Top-level test calls explicitly awaited to satisfy affected-file lint; assertions and production/coverage sources unchanged. Final focused tests rerun after this edit.
